title: Warm Energinzing Sweet Argentinian Serrano Ham Nigiri
description: Sweet and energizing argentinian snack featuring serrano ham, shaped like nigiri, served warm to bring out the flavors. Perfect for weeknights or special occasions.
instructions: Soak the sushi rice mix according to the package instructions, then set aside to cool.
Cut the serrano ham slices into thin strips, and set aside.
Mix the brown sugar and dijon mustard in a small bowl, and set aside.
Prepare a baking sheet or sushi mat with sesame oil for shaping the nigiri.
Once the sushi rice is cool, mix it with the brown sugar and dijon mustard mixture.
Shape the sushi rice mix into small nigiri shapes, and place a slice of serrano ham on top of each.
Drizzle the tops of the nigiri with sesame oil and garnish with sesame seeds and fresh cilantro.
Place the nigiri on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 5 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a minute or two, then serve warm.
Garnish with a slice of fresh orange and serve immediately.
